title: Payment-Record Multiplier for CondoGuard Coverage A Realignment
content:
Billing office rule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy connecting the policy's payment record to the Coverage A realignment rate.

**Rule.** The payment-record multiplier on the realignment rate is 1.05 when a payment on the policy was returned unpaid fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the realignment, 0.97 when the term is billed on the monthly EFT plan and no payment was returned within that time, and 1.00 when the term is on any other plan and no payment was returned within that time. The multiplier is applied to the tier's Coverage A rate per 1,000 USD, before the full-year realignment charge is rounded. Where that rate carries more than one multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the tier's rate; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Entries read.** Returned-payment entries on the policy's premium account, by the date each was posted, and the billing plan of the current term.

| Payment returned unpaid in the 12 whole months before the realignment | Billing plan of the term | Payment-record multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 1.05 |
| no | monthly EFT | 0.97 |
| no | annual, two-pay, quarterly or mortgagee escrow | 1.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Monthly EFT plan, a payment returned 4 months ago: the returned payment governs, 1.05.
- Monthly EFT plan, the only returned payment posted 12 whole months before the realignment: not within the time, 0.97.
- Quarterly plan, no returned payment: 1.00.
